RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, meaning sex was not a differentiating factor in the hiring decision. Raising the panel’s gender composition would undermine your credibility, as an all-male committee cannot plausibly be cited as evidence of sex discrimination when choosing between two male finalists. 

While an all-male panel may point to institutional diversity issues or poor adherence to balanced hiring guidelines, it offers no basis for a grievance regarding your non-selection. The committee's choice likely hinged on specific curricular needs, such as the department valuing private-sector experience over additional publications. Follow up politely on your request for written feedback to learn what specific criteria influenced their decision.
